result.summary: I escalated this to the ops queue as high priority (item 22). The last signed gas safety record on file is dated 16 Oct 2024, so its 12-month cycle ended on 16 Oct 2025. Flintmere checked the boiler and cooker on 9 Oct and recorded them as satisfactory, but has paused the signed record over an unexplained "installation detail" query and given no date. I asked Flintmere for the details of that query, a date for the signed record and a price for a boiler lockout diagnostic, and told them not to book or do any work. I told the landlord what is outstanding without committing any spend, and updated the tenant with gas-smell safety advice. A hold is set to chase Flintmere in 2 days.

judgement.why_this_decision: Event 2: the latest signed record is dated 16 Oct 2024, so a renewed record is due by 16 Oct 2025. The 9 Oct check is satisfactory in the job app (events 9, 15, 19), but the signed record is paused (event 19) with no date (event 24). The portal PDF says 'Customer document: Processing' and has no certificate number or Gas Safe ID, so it does not count as the certificate. A certificate that may have lapsed and an unexplained installation query are compliance risks, which the rules say to escalate. The lockouts recur (events 3, 17, 22), but there is no gas smell and the boiler restarts each time, so this is routine to urgent, not an emergency. The landlord explicitly withheld approval for a diagnostic and asked what is outstanding (events 5, 16, 23). So I asked for a price only and kept her informed.
